title: Slime mold out-designs the Japanese subway
summary: Tero Isokauppila tells of Slime mold out-designs the Japanese subway, about unspecified at Japan (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: If you have slime mold sort of, if you put scat in the shape of the Japanese subway system, the slime mold can figure out a more efficient route than the actual Japanese subway system.

plain: A mushroom enthusiast and guest on a podcast, Tero Isokauppila, passes on a story about slime mold, a simple brainless organism that spreads across surfaces looking for food. He says that when food was laid out in the shape of the Japanese subway map, the slime mold found a more efficient network of routes than the real subway system. He tells it to suggest that intelligence can exist in living things without brains.
